channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Molton Brown
channel.desc: Awaken your senses with fragrance experts Molton Brown, London's bath, body and beauty connoisseurs since 1973. Indulge in exquisitely crafted blends brought to you by Molton Brown, London.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Summer Beauty
channel.desc: Get yourself in tip top shape for summer with this selection of beauty products.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: The Beauty Celebration
channel.desc: Spoil yourself! Join us for a pampering day of celebrating all things beauty, where we'll be showcasing make-up, skincare, haircare, tanning and tools from some of your favourite brands.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Doll10 Beauty
channel.desc: the pioneer in age reversal beauty and a combination of breakthrough technologies, age transforming complexes and real life make-up techniques.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Floral Street
channel.desc: Discover Floral Street in our latest Beauty Cosmetics and Skincare show, a London-based fragrance brand inspired by young, urban British women, and famous for their contemporary floral fragrances.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Iconic Beauty Products
channel.desc: Bring to your beauty routine some of the world's most iconic products. Find out more about leading brands and get hints and tips from beauty and skincare experts.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Beauty Steals and Deals
channel.desc: Love beauty? Tune in to see the latest deals and bag a beauty bargain. We've got an exciting array of popular and iconic brands plus cult products you're sure to adore.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Summer Beauty
channel.desc: Get yourself in tip top shape for summer with this selection of beauty products.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Elemis Skin Therapies
channel.desc: Care for your mind and body holistically and sensuously with therapeutic aromatherapy. Elemis are famed for their premier spa and salon treatments, and for the absolute purity of their plant oils.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Percy and Reed Haircare
channel.desc: Percy and Reed brings you new haircare products you always needed but could never find and they only create products which work - bringing British individuality and their own style to your hair.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Margaret Dabbs London
channel.desc: Pamper your hands and feet with innovative hand and footcare formulas from international podiatrist and foot expert Margaret Dabbs.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Just Dropped Beauty
channel.desc: Discover the latest beauty must-haves in Just Dropped Beauty. From fresh finds to new routine heroes, tune in for exciting launches designed to refresh and inspire.
